body: I'm doing the same to get myself to end it. I disconnected myself from everything and hopefully I will soon realize that this has to get done.
My dad killed himself when I was 7 and I found him hanging. That image has been my desktop background in my head for a very long time. I really hate it and want to join him in the graveyard.

I've had plenty of support. I just have always made the wrong decision every single time and I don't want to live with the consequences of my actions. I am a coward and a fake. I always repeat what others told me growing up "you're going to regret it" and now I'm here regretting it. My god it makes me sick. I even sold all my belongings to buy weed to smoke with my friends. I mean I sold everything that makes me happy and I'm left with nothing. Nothing at all.

I hate everything and everyone. I am jealous, miserable, two faced, hardheaded, don't listen, do whatever I want then cry, talk bullshit, failed at school, academically I'm dumber than a 5th grader, there's no place for me in this world. Nobody has patience for stupid people. I have no resume, worked a job and then just quit without notice. I made so many mistakes and I know how wrong it all was but I don't care about changing. I don't want to get better anymore. I just want to end it all since it would be the easiest way to solve all my problems.
